definitions: To pursue a mistaken course of action.
To accuse or blame the wrong person.
examples: If you think I'm going to help you cheat, you're barking up the wrong tree.
The police were barking up the wrong tree for weeks before they found the real culprit.
She was barking up the wrong tree by trying to fix the software when the problem was with the hardware.
lemma: to bark up the wrong tree
synonyms: to be on the wrong track
to be wide of the mark
to be barking at the moon
source: to bark up the wrong tree
